snippet.title: The Chill of Ravenloft Teaser Trailer - Dungeons & Dragons Online
snippet.description:
Lamordia, the City of Dark Experiments. Step back into the haunting Mists of Ravenloft in the chilling new Dungeons & Dragons Online expansion.
Pre-purchase The Chill of Ravenloft now: ddo.com/chill-of-ravenloft
Unlock early access to the new Dhampir playable race, the Dark Bargainer Iconic Hero, the Mistwalker Movement Style, unique cosmetics, and more. All available now with pre-purchase!
Prepare to confront the scientific horrors crafted by the brilliant yet terrifying Dr. Viktra Mordenheim. Perhaps your courage will unravel the curse gripping Lamordia… if you live long enough to uncover the truth.
Choose your edition and claim your rewards before launch.
#DDO #TheChillofRavenloft #Ravenloft
